fields.question: string
fields.gold_answer: string or null, never invent missing answer
fields.gold_evidence_sets: list of alternative sufficient sets, each with document_id/span_id/offsets
fields.retrieved_context_sufficiency: FULL|PARTIAL|NONE|CONFLICT|UNKNOWN; define conflict resolution in guidelines
fields.derived_summaries: separate entries with provenance to original sources, not treated as primary evidence automatically
fields.claims: list with claim_id/text and ENTAILED|CONTRADICTED|NOT_SUPPORTED|UNCERTAIN plus cited and gold span IDs
fields.annotators: independent human IDs and original decisions, not AI impersonation
fields.split: development|calibration|sealed_test, group by source/topic where appropriate
